controller: Offline experiential food-discovery controller with supplied primitives, qualitative body care, local navigation and optional grounded dialogue
summaryDefinition: Totals and per-character means are explicitly named. Exact physiological/ecological numbers are developer instrumentation, not agent observations.
priors: Movement, water handling, local navigation, bodily sensation mapping, concurrent drives, primitive anatomy/actions, generic experiment exploration and offline dialogue are supplied. Food technique confidence requires executed sample outcomes and delayed effects. These probes do not retrain an LLM or establish a blank human mind.
independentSuccessDefinition: Absorbed calories/water and actually executed evidence are recorded separately from successful samples or sustained-effect counters. A tiny beneficial taste is not equivalent to a nutritionally sufficient meal. Long initial stored reserves can permit survival despite inadequate intake.
control: No learning-disabled comparison is presented; disabling one legacy value learner would not ablate the new memory, discovery and social scaffold.

scenarios.description: Fresh pond-side Aster and Mira, actual day/weather, finite first food web, no food knowledge or human instructions; two game days.

limitations: Two seeds and fixed geometry are functional probes, not statistical reliability or optimal-policy evidence.
Developer long probes may use an explicit 0.1-second timestep; their policy traces are not identical to native 1/60-second runs. Each trial records its actual timestep.
The ordinary window is two game days; it does not span a complete 120-day ecological year or establish indefinite self-sufficiency.
Plant species and animals have approximate configurable rates; bodies are not clinically calibrated.
Hot/night fixtures begin by an observable refuge and hold environmental overrides fixed; they do not establish distant refuge discovery.
Unanswered journal supplies initial generic questions only; no human reply or technique is injected.
Survival must be interpreted with absorbed/spent calories, water balance, health, stored reserves and outside-assistance measurements, not beneficial-sample counts alone.
No live Ollama, learned human language, human neural network, consciousness or civilization emergence is established.
Birth and full seasonal renewal may not occur in these windows; focused ecological tests must cover finite transfer and reproduction bounds.
